shared_metric_contract.state_rule: UNKNOWN, STALE, UNAVAILABLE, or NOT_EVALUATED may never render as verified green.
shared_metric_contract.parity_rule: The same metric_id must resolve to the same state, severity, freshness, source and evidence in Lite and Full.
shared_metric_contract.action_rule: G09 wireframes show only navigation/evidence affordances. C2 mutation controls are excluded.

interaction.card_click: Open corresponding Full section while preserving metric_id context.
interaction.mode_switch: Switch to Full without refetching or recomputing semantic state.
interaction.evidence: High/Critical cards expose evidence drilldown entry.

detail_pattern.evidence_drawer: Evidence reference and independent read-back details.
detail_pattern.graph_panel: Read-only module relationship visualization; no graph-owned routing or orchestration.

responsive_behavior.desktop: Lite uses card rows; Full uses persistent section navigation and evidence drawer.
responsive_behavior.narrow: Cards stack; Full navigation becomes section selector; ORGANIZATOR and AGENT lanes stack but boundary banner remains between them.
responsive_behavior.semantic_rule: Responsive transformation may change placement only, never metric meaning or ownership.

semantic_parity_checks: Every metric rendered in Lite exists in Full with identical metric_id.
Lite severity equals Full severity for the same metric_id.
Lite freshness equals Full freshness for the same metric_id.
Lite evidence_reference equals Full evidence_reference for the same metric_id.
Mode switching does not create a second source of truth.
Permission-aware visibility may hide detail but may not fabricate PASS or change underlying state.
